title: Teen entrepreneurs turn trash into Thanksgiving generosity
summary_full: Jean-Edmond Molnar and Jasper Pappas started a junk removal business named Junk Busters in Hudson. They are giving away 50 free Thanksgiving turkeys funded by their business profits at Henry Hudson Riverfront Park. This initiative aims to help local families who may struggle with the cost of traditional holiday meals. The teens repaired and donated items collected through their business rather than sending everything to landfills.
